method.purpose: Advisory moves of generic main-plane stitch; no native writes. Vias touching GND tracks, local islands, RF_CPWs or <=1.8 mm from any pad are protected. Already regular main grid and POWER screen fence retained.

method.regularity_policy: Regularity is a soft constraint. An already regular main stitch may move along the same row/column only when a measured route simplification requires it; local density, electrical return roles, filled-island connectivity and >=0.4mm edge clearance must be preserved.
